summary: CDT Equity Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Loan Agreement and issuance of a senior secured convertible promissory note to J.J. Astor Co. for a principal amount of $1,971,000, with net proceeds of $1,460,000 funded in two tranches. The note is payable over 24 weekly installments of $82,125 starting June 18, 2026, with conversion rights commencing December 11, 2026, subject to shareholder approval. A first priority lien on collateral was granted. This is a financing arrangement, not a transformative event, so it does not fit any special situations category.
